Journey from academic research to building scalable data systems at NexaData Solutions. Transitioned from theoretical data models to real-world engineering, driven by the challenge of turning raw data into actionable insights.  

Current Focus: Architecting and optimizing data pipelines that power our startup’s core analytics. Recently spearheaded a redesign of our ETL workflows, reducing data latency by 40% and improving warehouse query performance. Now working on integrating Snowflake with Apache Airflow to automate complex data orchestration, ensuring reliability at scale.  

Skills Highlight: Built and maintained data pipelines using Apache Spark, optimizing batch processing to handle 10TB+ datasets. Redesigned Redis caching layers to boost API response times by 30%. Leveraged Terraform for cloud infrastructure automation, cutting deployment time by 50%. Developed custom Python scripts to streamline data validation, reducing manual errors.  

Call to Action: Let’s connect if you’re shaping data strategies or tackling complex engineering challenges. I’m always curious about how others approach scaling data systems in fast-paced environments.
